### ClientApp/src/modules/media/components/MediaFolderExplorer.jsx

Sidebar folder navigation: Page selector, fixed 'Tất cả'/'Chưa phân loại' rows, breadcrumb, and the current level's folders with drag-and-drop asset-move support and always-visible management buttons (create-child/rename/delete). Being restructured into a persistent expandable tree per an active plan.

Imports: ClientApp/src/modules/media/components/MediaFolderExplorer.css

### ClientApp/src/modules/media/components/MediaFolderFormModal.jsx

Create/rename folder modal. In create mode, 'Gắn với Page' is a multi-select checklist: 0/1 Page selected keeps the legacy single-folder behavior with an auto-filled (still editable) name; 2+ Pages hides the name/parent fields and creates one folder per Page named after that Page.

Imports: ClientApp/src/modules/media/components/MediaFolderPickerTree.jsx

### ClientApp/src/modules/media/components/MediaFolderPickerTree.jsx

Lazy-loading recursive parent-folder picker used inside the create/rename modal. Loads only the root level eagerly; each node fetches its children only when expanded. excludeFolderId (the folder being edited) disables both expand and select on that node, making its whole subtree structurally unreachable — cycle prevention by construction, with the server's EnsureNoCycleAsync as the real backstop.

Imported by: ClientApp/src/modules/media/components/MediaFolderFormModal.jsx

### ClientApp/src/modules/media/components/MediaFolderSearchBox.jsx

Page-scoped folder search box in the sidebar: debounced keyword search showing name + fullPath, selecting a result calls the Explorer's openFolder, keeps a small local 'recently opened' list. Resets safely on Page switch using the same synchronous-render compare-before-query-key pattern as useMediaFolderExplorer.

### ClientApp/src/modules/media/hooks/useMediaFolderExplorer.js

State hook backing the Explorer: owns currentFolderId/selection/pageIndex (and, per the active tree-sidebar redesign, expandedFolderIds). Compares the incoming socialChannelId against a bound value synchronously during render (not in useEffect) so a Page switch resets state before that render's query key is computed, guaranteeing stale cross-Page responses can never leak into the UI; also purges React Query cache entries for the previous Page.

Imports: ClientApp/src/modules/media/hooks/useMediaFolders.js

Login/me/logout endpoints. Login validates credentials via ASP.NET Identity (UserManager/SignInManager) and issues a JWT with role claims; me re-reads the current user from JWT claims; logout is a stateless no-op (JWT has no server-side revocation).

### backend/Modules/Auth/JwtTokenService.cs

Builds and signs the HMAC-SHA256 JWT used for every authenticated request: claims include NameIdentifier, Name, Email, one Role claim per role, and an expiry from JwtSettings.AccessTokenMinutes.

### backend/Modules/MediaFolder/MediaFolderRepository.cs

Core folder repository: CreateAsync (parent Page inheritance/validation), UpdateAsync (reparent with EnsureNoCycleAsync walking up from the new parent to detect cycles), SoftDeleteAsync (blocks if active children exist; unclassifies media by setting FolderId=null), CreateAcrossPagesAsync (best-effort per-Page root folder creation), GetChildrenAsync/GetBreadcrumbAsync/SearchFoldersAsync (Page-scoped), and QueryWritableChannels/GetWritablePagesAsync/EnsureSocialChannelAccessAsync (shared ownership predicate for the single-check and list-all paths).

### backend/Modules/Notification/NotificationService.cs

Fire-and-forget notification writer (AddAsync swallows all exceptions, only logs a warning, so a broken notification write never breaks the calling business operation). Read state is team-shared, not per-user — MarkAllReadAsync flips ReadAt for every unread row at once. Currently only triggered from the ContentCrawl module despite PostPublished/PostFailed existing as generic enum values.
